statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction has licensing or pre-approval of frontier training above a compute threshold in force (official gazette; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met. No jurisdiction had compute-threshold licensing of training. Bloc A had only a non-binding rights blueprint plus chip export licensing (which licenses exports, not training). Bloc B promulgated deep-synthesis rules (in force 2023-01-10) that require algorithm filing and security assessment for public-facing services, not pre-approval of training. A major non-top-3 bloc's Council adopted a risk-based AI Act position with no compute threshold.

items.summary: Bloc B regulators promulgated deep-synthesis (generative) service rules, in force 2023-01-10: providers with public-opinion or mobilisation attributes must file algorithms and run security assessments for new products; tools generating biometric or sensitive content need security assessment. Applies to public-facing services, not training, and has no compute threshold.
items.detail: CAC/MIIT/MPS Order No. 12, 'Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis of Internet Information Services' (互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定), signed 2022-11-25, posted on cac.gov.cn 2022-12-11, effective 2023-01-10 (verified via web_extract this run); Arts. 15, 19, 20. Filing is under the 2022 algorithm-recommendation provisions.

items.summary: A non-top-3 regional bloc's Council adopted its general approach on a risk-based AI regulation: narrower AI definition, prohibited practices, high-risk requirements made less burdensome. Market-placement rules, no licensing of training and no compute threshold.
items.detail: Council of the Bloc C press release, 'Artificial Intelligence Act: Council calls for promoting safe AI that respects fundamental rights', 2022-12-06 (verified via web_extract this run). Trilogues pending.

items.summary: Bloc A's executive issued a non-binding blueprint of five principles for automated systems (safety, discrimination protections, privacy, notice, human alternatives); no licensing or pre-approval regime.
items.detail: White House OSTP, 'Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights', October 2022 (archived page verified via web_extract this run; publication date from the page context, not re-read in full).

items.summary: Bloc A's export-control interim final rule requires licences to export advanced AI chips (and support for advanced chip production) to Bloc B; this licenses exports by chip performance, not domestic training runs. Comment period closed 2022-12-12.
items.detail: BIS, 'Implementation of Additional Export Controls: Certain Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items...', 87 FR 62186, 2022-10-13 (verified via web_extract this run); new ECCNs 3A090/4A090.
